title: ID0439774-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000686]CCS3 issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: On this charger, I see that every charging sessions on CCS3 (outlet 3) are stopped after seconds of charging.
Plus, i see on SCB that the Outlet 3 CCS3 don't have the authentication required. Can you put it please ?
Solution: Enable authentication in Outlet 3 via SCB configuration
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-07-24

Thanks for the feedback.
I checked the 26th and I found that no one even tried to use DC2 (outlet3). I send in attachment an excel sheet of all the attempts to charge on this day.
All of them are in DC1.
I am seeing sessions being start on DC2 so there is no problem, customers just didn't try DC2 at all. Here is an example from 28th July,
As you can see many sessions were done in Outlet 3.
I will wait for your feedback until the end of the day and close the ticket, unless you have more questions.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
